record_grade=formal (Indonesia halal core, 2026-09-15).

【关键节点】2026-10-18 全面强制、官方不再延期。过渡期截止日为 2026-10-17（PP 42/2024 Pasal 160 ayat (2)/(3)、Pasal 161）；自次日 2026-10-18 起适用（BPJPH 公告 “mulai berlaku pada 18 Oktober 2026”）。BPJPH 已公开推进 Wajib Halal Oktober 2026，未见新的 UU/PP 延期原文。

PP 42/2024 (LN 2024/229, TLN 6998) implements UU 33/2014 and repeals PP 39/2021.
Direct legal basis for the 2026-10-18 mandate:
- Pasal 160(2) UMK food/beverage/slaughter transition until 17 Oktober 2026;
- Pasal 160(3) imported like products — Menteri by 17 Oktober 2026 after mutual recognition;
- Pasal 161 many non-food categories also until 17 Oktober 2026 (others 2029/2034).
Transition ends 2026-10-17; obligation applies from 2026-10-18.
Official Bahasa Indonesia PDF: https://cmsbl.halal.go.id/uploads/Salinan_PP_Nomor_42_Tahun_2024_tentang_Bidang_Penyelenggaraan_Jaminan_Produk_Halal_ce371e0e1e.pdf. Local MD5 170bdbf2c78ca86f848302fac2003b8e.
